title: Explainable AI

mapping.sentence: A model rejects someone, and the colorful explanation still cannot tell them why it happened.
mapping.cue: A person receives a rejection while a colorful model explanation fails to answer their question.
mapping.emotion: Quiet concern; gently emphasize “cannot tell them why”. Let the sentence land in an ordinary speaking voice, with no dramatic swell.

mapping.sentence: Explainable AI asks how to tell a persuasive account of a decision from evidence about how it was made.
mapping.cue: Place the displayed explanation beside a record of how the decision was actually made.
mapping.emotion: Clear curiosity; gently emphasize “evidence”. Let the sentence land in an ordinary speaking voice, with no dramatic swell.

mapping.sentence: It starts with a practical question: what does this person need the explanation to answer?
mapping.cue: Show the person’s specific question before introducing any method labels.
mapping.emotion: Patient care; gently emphasize “this person”. Let the sentence land in an ordinary speaking voice, with no dramatic swell.

mapping.sentence: Fixing a system, challenging a decision, and deciding whether to use it can require different explanations.
mapping.cue: Keep debugging, appeal and deployment questions as separate destinations from the same system.
mapping.emotion: Plain distinction; gently emphasize “different explanations”. Let the sentence land in an ordinary speaking voice, with no dramatic swell.

mapping.sentence: The book compares ways of highlighting inputs, testing possible changes, and examining the model’s inner workings.
mapping.cue: Highlight one input while its comparison baseline remains visible.
mapping.emotion: Accessible interest; gently emphasize “testing possible changes”. Let the sentence land in an ordinary speaking voice, with no dramatic swell.

mapping.sentence: A highlighted detail may still leave the person wondering what they could realistically do differently.
mapping.cue: Let the highlighted detail stop short of a feasible route around the person’s actual obstacle.
mapping.emotion: Human concern; gently emphasize “realistically do differently”. Let the sentence land in an ordinary speaking voice, with no dramatic swell.

mapping.sentence: Builders and users are invited to question an explanation as carefully as the decision it explains.
mapping.cue: A reviewer examines the explanation alongside the original decision.
mapping.emotion: Practical invitation; gently emphasize “as carefully”. Let the sentence land in an ordinary speaking voice, with no dramatic swell.

mapping.sentence: Begin with the rejected person, whose question the colorful dashboard has not yet answered.
mapping.cue: End with the person and an open practical question, rather than a completed correction.
mapping.emotion: Soft emphasis; gently emphasize “has not yet answered”. Let the sentence land in an ordinary speaking voice, with no dramatic swell.

notes: Source-specific visuals distinguish persuasive explanation from decision evidence, debugging/appeal/deployment needs, highlighting versus baseline, and feasible user action.
Approved spoken text and emotionalPlan remain unchanged.
No plan instruction or emotional-direction text is rendered on stage. Private author inspection only; independent review required before publication.

Independent production_1 review inspected every current-script frame full size in all three themes. Added practical rejection/person/question and reviewer composition; removed label collisions. No unsupported outcome or instructional overlay is shown.

independentReview.scope: Independent semantic and visual review of all 8 approved cues across 24 paused muted current-script frames in Color, Paper and Night.
